attributes.title: NPACE 2027 Newport: Catching the Next Wave
attributes.cme_provider: Nurse Practitioner Associates for Continuing Education
attributes.organizer: NPACE (Nurse Practitioner Associates for Continuing Education)
attributes.summary: NPACE holds its summer conference in Newport, Rhode Island, from June 29 to July 1, 2027, at the Wyndham Newport. The program covers current practice topics every advanced practice provider should know, and NPACE lists 18+ CE/CME credits. NPACE's 2027 conference guide lists full conference registration at $1,050, with discounts for students, military veterans and retired clinicians.
